rule: Verify the entire body structure and tail shape when identifying shark species.
failure_pattern: The model incorrectly identified a hammerhead shark as the most likely class due to its distinctive head shape, while the ground truth was a tiger shark.

rule: Prioritize the analysis of unique morphological features over color patterns when classifying birds.
failure_pattern: The model misclassified the bird as a White Wagtail due to its distinctive color pattern and markings, which are not characteristic of an Indigo Bunting.

rule: Analyze the bird's overall shape, coloration, and specific features such as beak shape and tail length to accurately identify the bird species.
failure_pattern: The model incorrectly identified a bird as a robin when the ground truth was an indigo bunting due to a misinterpretation of the bird's features.
